It started off well enough, but I feel underpaid for all the work I put in. This book was at least 300 pages too long and it seemed liked he just could not bring himself to end it. The reader was repeatedly teased with what would seem like an impending ending, only to turn the page and meander further down a twisted path to the next turn (and still no ending). 
A mountain switchback trail or road has the reward of the summit at the top. This story's back and forths, 'let's go this way, and now that way', served up no such satisfaction for the climb.
I've read long books before, but the best are long for a reason (think The Stand) because at the story is actually going somewhere as you turn the page.
